title.zh: 【Starknet 推出隐私原语 Shadow Accounts，应用可提供隐私模式切换】
title.en: 【Starknet 推出隐私原语 Shadow Accounts，应用可提供隐私模式切换】

current_state.zh: Starknet 已推出影子账户/Shadow Accounts 隐私原语；影子账户为受 STRK20 余额注资的伪名地址，可使用户开展公开 DeFi 活动并隐藏其与主钱包的关联，首个集成预计次日上线。
current_state.en: Starknet has launched Shadow Accounts; they are pseudonymous addresses funded from shielded STRK20 balances, enabling public DeFi activity while concealing the link to the main wallet, with the first integration expected the next day.

updates.title_zh: 【Starknet 推出隐私原语 Shadow Accounts，应用可提供隐私模式切换】
updates.title_en: 【Starknet 推出隐私原语 Shadow Accounts，应用可提供隐私模式切换】
updates.what_changed_zh: StarkWare推出Shadow Accounts，这是Starknet上的STRK20隐私原语，允许用户按应用切换匿名身份，并让开发者通过Starknet Wallet API为现有应用添加隐私功能，而无需重建这些应用。
updates.what_changed_en: StarkWare launched Shadow Accounts, a STRK20 privacy primitive on Starknet that lets users toggle per-app anonymous identities and lets developers add privacy to existing apps through the Starknet Wallet API without rebuilding them.
updates.current_state_zh: StarkWare推出Shadow Accounts，这是Starknet上的STRK20隐私原语，允许用户按应用切换匿名身份，并让开发者通过Starknet Wallet API为现有应用添加隐私功能，而无需重建这些应用。
updates.current_state_en: StarkWare launched Shadow Accounts, a STRK20 privacy primitive on Starknet that lets users toggle per-app anonymous identities and lets developers add privacy to existing apps through the Starknet Wallet API without rebuilding them.

updates.detailed_summary_en: StarkWare launched Shadow Accounts, a STRK20 privacy primitive on Starknet that lets users toggle per-app anonymous identities and lets developers add privacy to existing apps through the Starknet Wallet API without rebuilding them.

updates.title_zh: Starknet推出影子账户，支持用户匿名关联主钱包与DeFi活动
updates.title_en: Starknet推出影子账户，支持用户匿名关联主钱包与DeFi活动
updates.what_changed_zh: 补充说明影子账户是由受保护 STRK20 余额注资的独立伪名 Starknet 地址，用于在隐藏与主钱包关联的前提下参与公开 DeFi 活动；首个集成计划于次日上线。
updates.what_changed_en: Added that Shadow Accounts are pseudonymous Starknet addresses funded from shielded STRK20 balances for public DeFi activity while concealing the link to the main wallet; the first integration is scheduled for the next day.
updates.current_state_zh: Starknet 已推出影子账户/Shadow Accounts 隐私原语；影子账户为受 STRK20 余额注资的伪名地址，可使用户开展公开 DeFi 活动并隐藏其与主钱包的关联，首个集成预计次日上线。
updates.current_state_en: Starknet has launched Shadow Accounts; they are pseudonymous addresses funded from shielded STRK20 balances, enabling public DeFi activity while concealing the link to the main wallet, with the first integration expected the next day.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Starknet has introduced shadow accounts, pseudonymous Starknet addresses funded from shielded STRK20 balances that let users engage in public DeFi activity while concealing the link between that activity and their main wallet, with the first integration launching the following day.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Starknet has introduced shadow accounts, pseudonymous Starknet addresses funded from shielded STRK20 balances that let users engage in public DeFi activity while concealing the link between that activity and their main wallet, with the first integration launching the following day.
